evidence: Observed completed test run in this agent session before code freeze; tests were not rerun for documentation.
tests: owner bootstrap uses an explicit canonical id and app roles stay separate from forum titles and rank
only server-authorized owners can assign Tester or Owner to another user
self-role edits and removal of the final owner fail without changing access
role writes use revision checks, a closed field/role set and normal profile writes cannot bypass authority
role route enforces authentication, cookie CSRF and exact request Origin
role badges decorate rooms and fresh session cards without changing verified forum identity
persistent roles survive restart and bootstrap never promotes another configured id when an owner already exists
a service without a configured canonical owner never grants authority by name or client identity fields
verified group labels survive normalization; editable custom titles never become membership badges
profiles have shared authenticated identity and server-owned ranks; client cannot forge badges
older sessions cannot undo a newer Lolzteam identity refresh
friend requests require consent, deduplicate, notify only the target and support cancellation/removal
privacy preferences suppress unsolicited requests, invitations and native alert delivery
room invitations enforce sender membership, recipient identity and explicit acceptance without autoplay
expired/closed/banned room invitations cannot grant access
read acknowledgements are account-scoped and never accept an invitation
image upload validates bytes/size/ownership and serves a custom avatar without trusting external URLs
browser social mutations keep CSRF/origin guards
notification SSE streams only that account and immediately publishes changes
logout revokes an already open room SSE stream instead of retaining cached authorization
social profiles and friendships survive restart without provider secrets; persistence failure rolls back

deployment.name: Artemper
deployment.verificationSource: Release coordinator confirmed canonical identity and persisted role on the deployed server; this documentation task made no remote mutation.

limitations: UI screenshots use explicit test accounts and deterministic media SDK adapters, not real user accounts.
HTTP, SSE, DOM actions, role mutations and 360px layout checks were real in an isolated local service.
